artists.biography: BadBadNotGood (stylized as BADBADNOTGOOD, abbreviated as BBNG) are a Canadian music group from Toronto, Ontario. The group includes Matthew Tavares on keys, Chester Hansen on bass, Leland Whitty on saxophone, and Alexander Sowinski on drums. They are known for their interpretations of hip hop tracks and their collaborations with Tyler, The Creator; Earl Sweatshirt; Danny Brown; and Ghostface Killah.

BadBadNotGood.biography: BadBadNotGood (stylized as BADBADNOTGOOD, abbreviated as BBNG) are a Canadian music group from Toronto, Ontario. The group includes Matthew Tavares on keys, Chester Hansen on bass, Leland Whitty on saxophone, and Alexander Sowinski on drums. They are known for their interpretations of hip hop tracks and their collaborations with Tyler, The Creator; Earl Sweatshirt; Danny Brown; and Ghostface Killah.

perplexity.description:
BadBadNotGood’s IV, released in 2016 on Innovative Leisure Records, marks a pivotal moment in the Toronto-based jazz trio’s evolution. The album blends jazz with elements of hip-hop, electronic, and experimental rock, showcasing the group’s signature improvisational energy and genre-defying approach. Tracks like “And That, Too” and “Speaking Gently” highlight their intricate instrumentation and dynamic interplay, while collaborations with artists such as Sam Herring, Colin Stetson, and Kaytranada add further depth and texture to the record.

IV stands as a significant entry in BadBadNotGood’s discography, representing a shift toward a more expansive and collaborative sound compared to their earlier, more jazz-centric releases. The album received strong critical acclaim for its adventurous spirit and technical prowess, with reviewers praising its ability to bridge jazz traditions with contemporary influences. While not a mainstream commercial blockbuster, IV solidified the band’s reputation as innovators within the modern jazz landscape and helped broaden their audience beyond traditional jazz circles.
